name: Inspections need a trip each
summary: Keeps property inspections moving from booked visit to report: spots inspections waiting on an inspector, drafts the findings from the staff notes and photos on the job, and queues the owner's report for approval. Crons read and draft; a person approves every email.

covered_by.assign-inspector: person (allocate the inspector in ServiceM8; intake flags it)
covered_by.record-findings: draft (staff notes and photos on the job are read into a draft note)
covered_by.review-report: person (checks the photos and the note in ServiceM8)
covered_by.send-report: approval (the owner's email waits for approval)
covered_by.record-keeping: ServiceM8 job diary (attachments and the sent email stay on the job)

covered_by.record-findings: not yet (no kit mapping for these apps)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: Inspection jobs booked in ServiceM8 (Work Order status, matching the inspection words), with whether an inspector is allocated and whether the visit is marked done.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: For each finished visit, read the staff notes and photo count on the job and write a draft findings note on the job (internal, not sent).

crons.name: report
crons.summary: Queue the owner's report email, with the job's photos, for approval. Waits when the job has no owner email or no findings yet.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reads of jobs, allocations, contacts, notes and attachments, and one internal note on the job. The owner's email is a live operation and waits for a person.

servicem8.covers: job-system family: inspection jobs, allocations, staff notes, photos, the draft note and the owner's email

rex.covers: read-only viewing feedback snapshot, not rental condition inspections or owner reports

gaps: Inspection Express, Property Tree and 360 cameras: not in the kit's platform set, so nothing reads or writes them here.
Re-leased (inspection endpoints) and Vaultre (tenancy inspections) are mapped in the kit but no call or platform page in the evidence names them for this job. Not built here.
Assigning the inspector is a judgment step. The workflow flags the job; a person allocates the inspector in ServiceM8.
The inspection report PDF: ServiceM8 templated documents only produce Quote, Work Order and Invoice, so the report is a findings note plus photos, not a formatted PDF.
The cron cannot look at photos or judge condition. The findings are the staff notes; the person checks the photos before approving the email.
Follow-up on tenant or owner replies, reinspections and the sign-off step are not covered by the mapped operations.
The adapter is docs-only until a ServiceM8 trial account proves the field names and the email attachment behaviour.

Rex inspection feedback means a viewing. Set platform to rex to read feedback into rex-viewings/current. No condition reports, inspector allocation, appointment tracking or owner emails are provided. The appointments sample has no row fields; no fields are inferred. PropertyMe remains unmapped.
